item: FR2-07 A single verification contract (audit-3, fix-2 commits 46e2d0c..33b0aaa, HEAD 33b0aaa)
blocked_root_cause: The expect.text contract promises RENDERED text but is implemented through proxies (Range client rects + computed visibility + Element.checkVisibility + parent-side frame-element checks). For <text> inside SVG never-rendered containers (<defs>, <symbol> without <use>, <mask>, <clipPath>, <pattern>, <marker>, a nested <svg> inside <defs>) Chrome 154 reports non-empty rects, visibility:visible and checkVisibility()==true (svg-primitives.log), so the product returns verified:true for text that is never painted (pixel oracle 0/0). SPEC and IMPLEMENTATION are both partly wrong: the spec equates 'rendered' with primitives that are not equivalent to painting, and the implementation has no exclusion for SVG never-rendered subtrees. TESTS were not wrong but incomplete: the generated matrix enumerates CSS mechanisms x placements only and never generates SVG. Unlike the audit-1/2 findings this is a finite, spec-defined set (SVG 2 'never-rendered elements' plus <defs> content), so a bounded fix exists; alternatively the spec can list it as a documented counted case.

ac_results.required_fix: Exclude text whose flat-tree ancestor chain contains an SVG never-rendered container (defs, symbol, mask, clipPath, pattern, marker, and the gradient/filter elements) before the rects/checkVisibility test; the <use> instance tree is a closed UA shadow root the walker cannot enter, so a <symbol>/<defs> subtree referenced by a live <use> must still count (probe svg2-use-of-symbol is painted and verified today) or be reported unavailable, never contradicted; add SVG rows to the unit and live matrices, or narrow the documented contract to list this as counted

findings.summary: Case H2 carries a second tolerance (relaxedFound: accepts unverifiable 'did not answer') that is NOT counted by Z-gap325-budget. In both of my clean runs it fired on the bundle surface (2/2; 'only 7 of 9' and 'only 5 of 9 frames answered'), so H2 did not exercise its intent there; the builder's claim 'GAP-325 tolerances that fired: NONE' is true only of the capped tolerance. It never accepts verified:true.

Mutant G1 (every SHOWN cross-origin frame never answers; hidden ones still judged from the parent side) SURVIVES the unit suite (browser 840/840). Live it is caught: Z-gap325-budget fails on mcp and bundle (tolerance list far above 3), CLI M:iframe-cross-origin|none|- fails directly; the SDK surface alone masks it (1 tolerated <= cap). So the cap does protect the matrix, but no unit test pins 'a cross-origin frame that answers found => found'.

findings.severity: minor/info, false contradicted on rendered text
findings.summary: Rendered text split across inline-block or flex items (visually adjacent, painted) and <textarea> content are reported contradicted. Block boundaries are partly documented in GAP-324; textarea is not.

GAP-325 states ~1 in 200 page loads; the builder's own probe-reruns/k11-repro.jsonl 'parse' mode shows the visible cross-origin frame silent in 2 of 3 reps. Fail-closed in every instance (never a false pass), but the stated rate understates it for pages whose cross-origin frames exist at parse time.

gap325_tolerance_assessment: Honest for what it is: isGap325 requires success:true, verified:false, tier 'unverifiable', expect.text 'not-run' and a silent 'hung:http://localhost:' frame, so it can never accept verified:true; it is capped at 3 per surface and the cap detects a systematic cross-origin regression live (G1). Weaknesses: unit tests do not catch G1, the SDK surface alone would mask it, and the separate H2 relaxedFound tolerance is uncapped and fired 2/2 on the bundle in my runs.
focus_parse_before_check: Not a regression. My own repro (probes/focus-xo.mjs: hidden + visible cross-origin frames at parse time BEFORE the target cross-origin frame, browser.focus #xo-in): master c83c220 action-failed 4/10 ('No element found for selector: #xo-in'); HEAD 0/10 then 4/12 with the identical error; 'after' order 10/10 and 12/12 on both. Every HEAD verified focus had the parent-side oracle confirm the target iframe is document.activeElement (verified-but-parent-not-target = 0). Element resolution is untouched by FR2-07 (only checkFocus is added after the handle resolves).
